items.title: Anthropic启动IPO路演，估值已缩水6000亿美元
items.summary: Anthropic启动IPO路演，拟以70-78美元/股发行8.25亿股，交易规模最高约643.5亿美元，但估值已从2万亿美元缩水至1.4万亿美元；2026年Q3营收169.56亿美元，年化运行率达810亿美元，客户数突破1.19万家，但算力成本占比升至58%导致营业利润率下滑，且未来十年面临约9000亿美元采购承诺。
items.why_now: Anthropic今日正式启动IPO路演，11月19日纳斯达克上市首日或迎221亿美元抛售。
items.why_now_en: 19日纳斯达克开市首日即面临220亿美元解禁抛压。
items.summary_en: Anthropic has initiated its IPO roadshow, planning to issue 825 million shares at $70–$78 per share for a maximum raise of $64.35 billion, with a fully diluted valuation of approximately $1.4 trillion, down from earlier expectations of $2 trillion. The company reported Q3 revenue of $16.956 billion, up 12.27 times year-over-year, though compute costs rose to $9.863 billion (58% of revenue) and adjusted operating margins slipped to 15%, against a backdrop of $900 billion in long-term infrastructure commitments. The IPO includes a $26 billion private strategic investment from major chipmakers and cloud providers, including $1 billion each from Google and Nvidia, alongside 250 million shares available for sale by early investors on the first trading day, November 19.

items.title: OpenRouter 实测六模型并给出四层防护，解决 AI Agent 无限循环烧钱问题
items.summary: OpenRouter 基于 @openrouter/agent 0.11.0 发布教程，通过 doom-loop 检测、loopKey 参数归一化、stopWhen 步数与成本上限及 API 密钥额度四层防护，解决 AI Agent 因工具失败陷入死循环且成本指数级增长的问题。实测数据显示，开启死循环检测后，六模型在全部 18 次运行中有 16 次在第三次相同调用时被拦截，工具调用次数从 314 次降至 64 次，总花费从 $0.29 降至 $0.05，有效防止了单夜空转数千美元的极端损耗。
items.why_now: OpenRouter 刚发布 SDK 0.11.0 实测防护方案，即刻阻断 Agent 无限循环烧钱风险。
items.why_now_en: OpenRouter SDK 0.11.0 release caps runaway AI agent costs.
items.summary_en: OpenRouter’s Agent SDK (v0.11.0) implements a four-layer defense against infinite AI agent loops, including `doomLoop` detection, parameter normalization via `loopKey`, and `stopWhen` limits, which reduced tool calls from 314 to 64 and costs from $0.29 to $0.05 across six tested models. Enabling `doomLoop: true` blocks the third identical call and stops execution by the sixth, while `stopWhen` sets hard limits on steps and costs, backed by a final layer of API key credit limits that returns a 402 error to prevent unbounded spending.

items.title: [AINews] Mercor $750m Series D at $20B valuation, $3B run rate
items.summary: Mercor完成200亿美元估值的7.5亿美元D轮融资，其年化收入已突破30亿美元，拥有500万专家网络。该数据供应商的推理成本支出达到员工薪资的3倍，若此比率随AI普及保持，预计未来五年将推动GDP实现接近3倍于常态的双位数增长。
items.why_now_en: Gemini 4 Carbon price doubles in 4 days.
items.summary_en: Mercor raised a $750M Series D at a $20B valuation, achieving a $3B annualized run rate with 5 million experts. The company reports spending 3x as much on AI inference as on employee salaries, projecting that this trend could drive double-digit GDP growth over the next five years. Additionally, Google released Gemini 4 Carbon for long-horizon agentic tasks, scoring 60.4% on CursorBench and 94.2% on ARC-AGI-2 at $0.38 per task, and pricing it at $4/$20 per million tokens for developers.

items.title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
items.summary: CoreWeave第三季度营收达36.6亿美元，同比增长168%，但亏损7.09亿美元，正转向通过客户预付款和短期合同融资，预计未来三个月将收取约90亿美元预付款，并利用26亿美元DDTL 5.5贷款支持短期业务。该公司将短期合同定价提升至每兆瓦每年超过4000万美元，远高于4至5年期合同的2000万至2500万美元，试图摆脱对无担保债务市场的依赖以应对巨额基础设施积压订单。

items.title: anthropics/skills
items.summary: Anthropic 开源了 Agent Skills 标准及示例库，通过包含指令、脚本和资源的文件夹让 Claude 动态加载以执行文档生成、数据分析等特定任务，其中 docx、pdf 等核心文档技能均遵循 Apache 2.0 协议公开。开发者可直接在 Claude Code 中通过 `/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills` 命令安装插件，或使用包含 YAML 前置元数据和具体指令的 `SKILL.md` 文件创建自定义技能，该能力已通过 Claude.ai 付费版及 API 全面开放。
items.why_now: Anthropic开源技能库，独立开发者即刻获得生产级文档处理等能力，低成本增强AI应用。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's open-source `anthropics/skills` repository defines Agent Skills as folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to perform specialized tasks repeatably. The repo includes Apache 2.0-licensed document generation skills (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx) used in production, alongside creative and enterprise examples, and can be integrated via Claude Code plugins, Claude.ai paid plans, or the API.

items.title: mattpocock/skills
items.summary: Matt Pocock 发布了名为“Skills for Real Engineers”的工程代理技能包，通过 /grill-me 等指令解决 AI 代理开发中的需求错位与输出冗余问题，强调小模块化设计以保持用户控制权并兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等主流工具。其安装方式支持插件自动更新或 npx 手动同步，需执行 /setup-matt-pocock-skills 初始化，目前已有约 60,000 名开发者通过其通讯订阅获取更新。
items.why_now_en: 60K devs already use these new agent skills.
items.summary_en: Matt Pocock released "skills.sh," a collection of composable agent skills for engineering tasks that supports Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, and other tools via specific plugin or npx installation commands. The suite addresses common AI agent failure modes through targeted prompts like /grill-me for requirement alignment and /grill-with-docs for detailed pre-development questioning. Setup involves a 30-second installation process followed by running /setup-matt-pocock-skills in each repository to configure issue trackers and labeling conventions.

items.title: Show HN: Paper Radar – daily ArXiv triage, now runs on Claude Haiku too
items.summary: Paper Radar 利用 TypeSafe 的 Jev-1.13 模型或 Claude Haiku 处理 arXiv 每日约 1,500 篇新论文，通过返回概率值而非生成摘要，将每日全库筛查成本控制在约 6 美分。该工具在 Cochrane 审查基准测试中复现了 96.9% 的纳入研究并削减了 78% 的阅读工作量，用户只需 Fork 仓库并在 GitHub Actions 中配置 `radar.toml` 兴趣参数及 API 密钥即可实现基于 GitHub Pages 的定制化论文推送。

items.title: Gemini Decisions API
items.summary: Google发布Gemini Decision 1模型API，支持文本、图像、音频、视频和PDF等全多模态输入，相比Jev（仅限文本和JSON）和OpenAI（文本和图像），其多模态能力更为全面。该API定价为每百万输入token 10美分且输出免费，与OpenAI GPT-6 Luna决策模型持平，而竞品Jev以每百万4.2美分的价格仍保持成本优势。与Jev和OpenAI直接返回0.0或1.0的二值结果不同，Gemini Decision 1在是非类问题中返回概率值（如0.92或0.04），体现了不同的置信度输出机制。
items.why_now: Gemini刚发布全模态决策API，免费输出且支持视频，抢占多模态窗口。
items.why_now_en: Google's multimodal decision API undercuts rivals with free outputs.
items.summary_en: Google's new "Gemini Decision 1" API is the first fully multimodal decision model, supporting text, images, audio, video, and PDFs, unlike Jev's text-only and OpenAI's text-and-image capabilities. Priced at 10 cents per million input tokens with free output, it sits between Jev ($4.20) and GPT-6 Luna in cost, and uniquely returns probability values (e.g., 0.92) rather than binary 0/1 outputs for yes/no queries.

items.title: Runway 开源 27B 世界动作模型 Praxis-1，权重采用 Apache 2.0 许可
items.summary: Runway 开源 27B 参数混合专家扩散 Transformer 模型 Praxis-1，权重及推理代码均采用 Apache 2.0 许可，支持 LoRA 微调并已在 NVIDIA RoboLab-120 榜单以 46.2% 的成功率超越 FLUX 3 Action（42.9%）和 Cosmos3 Nano（36.8%）。该模型可通过 GitHub 和 Hugging Face 获取，兼容 H100、RTX 5090 及 Jetson Thor 等硬件，针对未见过的 RT-1 机器人微调后在 SimplerEnv 上成功率达 80.0%，显著优于原始策略的 52.4%。
items.why_now: 27B模型Apache 2.0全开放，支持RTX 5090和Jetson Thor部署，今日起可自托管微调。

items.title: Google 发布 Gemini Decisions API 与 Gemini Decision 1 模型，专注快速多模态封闭式决策
items.summary: Google 发布 Gemini Decisions API 及 Gemini Decision 1 模型，支持在 150-250ms 端到端延迟内，对文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF（上限 256K tokens）一次性评估最多 1000 个封闭式决策问题。该模型通过单次前向传递直接对候选选项打分而非逐 token 生成，输入价格仅为每百万 token 0.10 美元且输出免费，成本比 Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite 低近 5 倍。
items.why_now: Gemini Decisions API 今上线且免输出费，150ms 内完成多模态千题判断，即刻替代自训分类器。

items.title: a16z 提出 B2A 经济：AI 智能体正成为新的流量与分发渠道
items.summary: a16z 提出 B2A 经济概念，指出 AI 智能体已占多数网络流量，Shopify 2026 年第一季度来自 AI 的订单增长近 13 倍，且智能体浏览器流量在 8 月至 10 月间增长 8 倍（Muse 占 60%，OpenAI 占 30%）。数据显示，超过 40% 的 GitHub PR 始于智能体起草，Stripe 智能体贡献了其文档流量近 40% 及 API CLI 请求的 70%，而 Vercel 由智能体触发的部署在一年内增长 28 倍。
items.why_now: OpenAI 刚推出企业认领功能，智能体正成为新流量渠道，窗口期已至。
items.why_now_en: OpenAI's new Businesses feature lets brands claim profiles and insights in ChatGPT today.
items.summary_en: a16z has outlined the "B2A" (Business-to-Agent) economy, projecting that AI agents will drive significant platform shifts as they account for most web traffic and 50% of newly published articles by 2026. Key infrastructure metrics highlight this acceleration: Shopify saw AI-driven traffic grow 8x and AI search orders increase 13x in Q1 2026, while Vercel reported a 28x surge in agent-triggered deployments and Stripe recorded that agents initiated 70% of its API CLI requests. Enterprises are increasingly treating agents as primary distribution channels and customers, leveraging plugins and MCPs to enable agents to autonomously evaluate, select, and purchase products, thereby reshaping revenue models and user acquisition strategies.

Show HN: Agent skill and Claude/Codex plugins for Google Ads campaigns

items.summary: OpenAI推出ChatGPT“企业”测试版，允许品牌免费认领认证档案并部署专属AI代理，通过付费广告直接引流至对话场景，仪表盘可监控提及量及“发现主题”以优化品牌曝光。Anthropic同期推出Claude电子表格、白板及数据工具，支持通过提示词生成Excel文件、将公司指标转化为视频叙事，并新增会议助手与Adobe、Atlassian连接器，实现跨应用深度整合。
items.why_now: OpenAI刚推出品牌入驻ChatGPT功能，付费广告可绑定AI代理，独立开发者需立即适配此新流量入口。
items.why_now_en: OpenAI's new free "Businesses" beta lets brands claim ChatGPT profiles immediately.
items.summary_en: OpenAI has launched a beta "Businesses" hub enabling brands to claim free verified profiles and track ChatGPT mentions, while U.S. online retailers and digital service firms can deploy custom AI agents for shopper interactions that now serve as labeled landing spots for paid ads. Additionally, Anthropic expanded its Claude ecosystem with beta releases of Sheets and Whiteboards, a generally available Data analytics tool, and an in-call meeting assistant, alongside upgraded connectors that integrate external apps like Adobe and Atlassian directly into the platform.

items.title: 当美国无法建设数据中心，会对 AI 产生怎样的冲击
items.why_now: 得州等州今冬起冻结新数据中心审批，2028年起AI算力增长将被腰斩。
items.why_now_en: 21 US data centers canceled, 41% frozen by 2027.
items.summary_en: At least 21 large US data center projects were canceled between July and November 2024, with new governors in Texas, Ohio, and Georgia freezing approvals for approximately 158.6 GW of planned capacity, representing roughly 41% of the national pipeline. This construction freeze would cap total US data center capacity at 120–150 GW by 2028, potentially stranding tens of millions of Blackwell-class GPUs and cutting effective annual AI compute growth from 12–15x to approximately 6x by 2030. While frontier model training will proceed on existing infrastructure, the shortage will force a shift toward token limits and intensified competition for finite power between inference and training workloads.

items.title: 10 亿 Token 开源万只假鸟， AI 伪科普正在「污染」下一代的常识
items.why_now_en: eBird bans AI uploads, locking out a critical market gap for solo founders.

items.title: WSJ 报道 Nvidia 董事会接近决定是否罢免 CEO 黄仁勋
AI Roleplay Apps: Korean Playbooks, 18+ Ratings, App Store Bans
items.why_now: 苹果十月下架多款角色扮演应用，迫使竞品转战Web端以规避封禁风险。
items.why_now_en: Apple’s October bans open web-first launch window
items.summary_en: AI roleplay apps like Emochi ($45M ARR) and free-tier Chai ($120M run-rate) monetize via subscriptions and memory upgrades, but face regulatory pressure with Apple banning major 18+ apps from the US store in October 2025. Companies increasingly prioritize web-first launches to bypass App Store restrictions, as seen with Janitor drawing 2.5M daily web users before shipping its iOS app. Legal actions against unauthorized character usage are rising, with Kakao Entertainment and others suing Scatter Lab over copyright infringement, while platforms like Disney and Naver Webtoon pivot toward licensing or creator-approved content to mitigate rights risks.

items.title: Anthropic's IPO roadshow video
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s IPO roadship video reveals a multi-chip strategy for training and serving Claude across AWS Trainium, Google TPUs, NVIDIA, and AMD GPUs, a bet co-founder Tom Brown describes as unconventional due to the significant cost of building separate software stacks. The company highlighted that an internal model, Mythos, ported nearly 100% of the kernels to AMD GPUs in just three days with minimal human intervention, compared to the previous months-long process involving dozens of engineers. Anthropic also emphasized its advantage in discovering "compute multipliers," such as a 4x factor that reduces the physical compute needed for a specific model from 100 to 25 units, and predicts these multipliers will stack as Claude advances toward recursive self-improvement.

items.title: aws-emulator
items.summary_en: AWS has released an official emulator allowing developers to test against a local clone of its services without paid API keys, currently requiring Docker on macOS or Windows. The tool was developed in Rust by a swarm of agents that generated 29,684 commits in its first three weeks.

items.title: meta/astryx
items.summary: Meta 开源了完全定制化且支持 AI Agent 协作的设计系统 Astryx，该系统基于 React 19+ 和 StyleX 构建，提供 150+ 无障碍组件及品牌级主题功能。作为 Meta 内部使用最广的系统，Astryx 曾驱动超过 13,000 个应用，其核心优势在于通过 CSS 自定义属性实现无封装定制，并采用开放内部结构，使人手与 AI 助手能基于相同工具链无缝协作。
items.summary_en: Meta Astryx is an open source, agent-ready design system built on React 19+ and StyleX that powers over 13,000 internal Meta apps and ships with more than 150 accessible components. It distinguishes itself through a "no lock-in" approach that exports internal building blocks directly for composition and allows styling overrides via Tailwind or CSS modules without build plugins. The system includes a CLI and documentation designed so that human developers and AI agents can use the same tooling and references to build applications.

items.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang承认与疑似中国间谍、新加坡AI基础设施公司Megaspeed高管Alice Huang有婚外情，该公司两年内购入48亿美元Nvidia芯片并涉嫌向中国非法转运。事件升级后，纽约时报报道Huang还与直接向其汇报的副总裁Kimberly Powell存在婚外情，导致公司董事会筹划将其撤职，股价盘后下跌约8%；美国司法部已接管对Megaspeed的联邦调查，国会计划传唤Huang说明情况。
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang faces a national security probe and potential board ouster after admitting to an affair with Singapore-based Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom U.S. officials suspect is a Chinese spy who acquired $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips through a network including the Shanghai Century Litong cloud partner. A second reported extramarital relationship with Nvidia VP Kimberly Powell triggered an 8% after-hours stock drop and a Congressional subpoena plan, exacerbating concerns over Nvidia’s role in the U.S.-China AI chip arms race.

items.title: United Airlines bans AI agents from booking flights on behalf of travelers
items.summary: 美航于周三禁止未经授权的第三方AI代理（如Meta Muse和OpenAI Dots）代表旅客进行机票预订，以防范敏感信息泄露及潜在的联邦法规违规风险。该政策旨在抵制AI机器人大量搜索航班带来的成本压力，与西南航空允许ChatGPT访问其航班库存的开放策略形成鲜明对比，但美航票价仍可通过Kayak等聚合平台查询。
items.summary_en: United Airlines has banned third-party personal AI agents, such as Meta's Muse and OpenAI's dots, from making flight reservations on behalf of travelers, citing security risks and potential violations of federal regulations regarding in-person luggage verification. The airline is restricting access through its digital platforms and travel aggregators to prevent the use of unauthorized AI assistants that may expose sensitive payment information or generate costly unintended purchases. While United continues to allow bookings via established aggregators like Kayak and Google Flights, this move contrasts with Southwest Airlines' strategy, which permits ChatGPT users to access its flight inventory directly.

items.title: Writing a SIGGRAPH paper from scratch
items.summary: 作者利用在沃尔玛实习期间购买的RTX 3090 Ti显卡，自研了“InfiniteDiffusion”无限生成算法并开发“Terrain Diffusion”程序化地形生成器，最终成功发表SIGGRAPH 2026论文。该Minecraft模组被AsianHalfSquat展示给超过100万观众，论文推特发布及Two Minute Papers科普视频均获近百万浏览量，并登上HackerNews首页。

items.title: The Web Is More Than Enough
items.summary: 作者推出的网页版办公套件 tinylittleoffice.com 吸引超20万人访问，其托管成本仅为每月0美元，证明了现代浏览器凭借 Web Crypto API、WebAssembly、WebGL 和 Web Audio API 等底层技术，已具备构建复杂高性能应用的能力。相比传统开发方式，利用这些原生浏览器技术可大幅降低应用开发与分发门槛，使得如 Simon Willison 的非专业游戏开发者也能在浏览器中实现支持多人离线对战的3D游戏 Battle Drones。

items.title: Why the data center you dread might never even be built
items.summary: 尽管数据中心建设面临电力紧张、许可延迟及本地居民强烈反对等现实障碍，但更核心的问题在于大量已宣布的项目可能根本无法落地。TechCrunch的Equity播客邀请Ascend Analytics的高级管理总监Brent Nelson，针对数十亿美元的AI基础设施投资，分析了如何从众多投机性项目中筛选出真正具备可行性并能够最终建成的大型数据中心。

items.title: How backlash and red tape continue to slow data centers post-Blue Wave
items.summary: Ascend Analytics高管Brent Nelson指出，当前数据中心项目管线严重虚高，因广泛的地方反对、许可延迟及电力短缺，仅有一小部分已宣布的项目能实际建成。他强调自然气并非可靠的能源后备方案，特别是在极端冬季天气下，并建议将电池存储与可临时削减的电网连接配对作为替代方案，同时呼吁民主党组织推动许可制度改革以避免基础设施泡沫破裂带来的风险。
items.summary_en: Ascend Analytics’ Brent Nelson argues the data center pipeline is wildly inflated, with only a fraction of announced AI infrastructure projects likely to be built due to local opposition, permitting delays, and electricity scarcity. To address grid bottlenecks, the episode proposes pairing battery storage with curtailable grid connections as a more viable alternative to unreliable natural gas fallbacks during extreme weather.

items.title: Nvidia’s stock drops as board reportedly preps to oust CEO Jensen Huang
items.summary: Nvidia 董事会正考虑解雇领导公司33年的 CEO Jensen Huang，受其被曝与中国情报人员及下级高管存在婚外情丑闻影响，Nvidia 股价在周三盘后下跌约 8%，过去五天累计跌幅达 11%。由于 Huang 拥有约 60 名直接下属且公司缺乏明确的继任计划，Nvidia 正与外部机构合作寻找潜在的新任 CEO 人选。

items.title: $0 in sales, 5 channels live: what I fixed when my $9 prompt pack wouldn't sell
items.summary: 作者发布在 Ko-fi 的 $9“AI 工作流包”（含 25 个提示词及 4 个实测工作流）目前销量为 0，核心障碍在于缺乏自然流量及信任机制，而非产品本身。通过修正分发策略，作者将教程引流至 Dev.to 建立权威，并在漏斗顶端提供免费样本（3 个提示词+1 个工作流）降低决策门槛，同时修复了 Bluesky 及 AI 工具目录等 5 个渠道的列表分类与展示问题，目标锁定为每月 3 单（约 $20 净利润）以覆盖工具订阅成本。

items.title: 卷起来了！11月11日，大模型厂商在天猫打5折
items.summary: 11月11日双11期间，智谱、MiniMax、千问办公、阿里云及Qoder在天猫AI空间站推出Token充值服务，折扣低至19.9元（Qoder月卡3.3折），用户可通过淘宝搜索“Token”进入充值中心购买。Token首次作为独立品类登上天猫双11，标志着大模型应用从B端开发工具向大众消费领域拓展。
items.summary_en: On November 11, major AI model providers including Zhipu, MiniMax, Alibaba Cloud, Qwen Office, and Qoder offered 50% discounts on token plans via Tmall’s new "Token" category, with prices starting as low as ¥19.9 for Qoder. This marks the first time tokens have been treated as an independent consumer commodity on Tmall, signaling the transition of large language models from enterprise APIs to mass-market consumer products.

directions.name: AI算力成本熔断器 (ComputeGuard)
directions.description: 一个实时监控AI应用Token消耗与算力成本的API网关，当成本增速超过预设阈值时自动降级模型或阻断请求，并生成优化建议。
directions.description_en: A real-time API gateway that monitors AI token consumption and compute costs, automatically downgrading models or blocking requests when cost growth exceeds thresholds, and generating optimization suggestions.
directions.target_user: 使用高成本LLM API的独立开发者、SaaS创始人及AI初创团队
directions.target_user_en: Indie developers, SaaS founders, and AI startups using high-cost LLM APIs
core_features: 多维度成本监控与预算警报（按项目/用户/功能）
智能路由与自动降级（高成本请求自动切换至低成本模型）
API级Token消耗分析与优化报告
core_features_en: Multi-dimensional cost monitoring and budget alerts (by project/user/feature)
Smart routing and auto-downgrading (automatically switch high-cost requests to cheaper models)
API-level token consumption analysis and optimization reports
directions.why_now: Anthropic IPO路演显示其算力成本占比已升至58%，且面临未来十年9000亿美元采购承诺，这标志着AI行业从'拼模型能力'转向'拼成本控制'。社区中关于'LLM账单爆炸'的讨论热度极高，独立开发者急需在应用层解决'API成本失控'的痛点，而当前缺乏专门针对开发者的成本熔断与智能路由工具。
directions.why_now_en: Anthropic's IPO roadshow reveals that compute costs have risen to 58% of expenses, with a 900B USD commitment over the next decade, signaling a shift in the AI industry from 'model capability' to 'cost efficiency'. Community discussions about 'LLM bill shock' are at a fever pitch, and indie developers urgently need application-layer solutions for 'uncontrolled API costs', yet there is a lack of dedicated cost circuit-breaker and smart routing tools.
directions.monetization: SaaS订阅制（免费层限制监控请求数，付费层解锁自动降级与高级报表）+ 企业级私有化部署许可
directions.monetization_en: SaaS subscription (free tier with limited monitored requests, paid tier for auto-downgrading and advanced reports) + Enterprise on-premise licensing
directions.source_article: Anthropic启动IPO路演，估值已缩水6000亿美元
